lines.speaker: forestfairy
lines.text: Hello??

lines.speaker: forestfairy
lines.text: Are you that Commander everyone's talking about?

lines.speaker: forestfairy
lines.text: Are you interested in hearing some secrets about the Nikkes?
What kind of secrets?
I am.

lines.speaker: forestfairy
lines.text: You are?

lines.speaker: forestfairy
lines.text: If you are willing to help me, I'll share some juicy ones with you.
Sure, why not?

lines.speaker: forestfairy
lines.text: That was fast!

lines.speaker: forestfairy
lines.text: That must be why everyone's talking about you.

lines.speaker: forestfairy
lines.text: Then you'll help me??

lines.speaker: forestfairy
lines.text: For someone like you, it'll be a walk in the park.
Let's hear it.

lines.speaker: forestfairy
lines.text: I'll take it as a yes, then??

lines.speaker: forestfairy
lines.text: Can you get me a Rapture core??

lines.speaker: forestfairy
lines.text: One that's fully intact.

lines.speaker: forestfairy
lines.text: Everything that comes into the Ark has already been picked over,

lines.speaker: forestfairy
lines.text: so it's difficult to examine.
Examine?

lines.speaker: forestfairy
lines.text: NIMPH.

lines.speaker: forestfairy
lines.text: Have you heard of it?
Yes, I have.

lines.speaker: forestfairy
lines.text: You have?

lines.speaker: forestfairy
lines.text: Seems like you know a lot.

lines.speaker: forestfairy
lines.text: Then I assume you know what it does as well?
Indeed I do.

lines.speaker: forestfairy
lines.text: Good, that'll make this easier.

lines.speaker: forestfairy
lines.text: I don't think this NIMPH is human technology.

lines.speaker: forestfairy
lines.text: Using nanomachines to take control of the brain... is crazy!

lines.speaker: forestfairy
lines.text: You know what's even crazier?

lines.speaker: forestfairy
lines.text: No one knows how to make NIMPH.

lines.speaker: forestfairy
lines.text: They don't even know what the necessary technology is.

lines.speaker: forestfairy
lines.text: Do you know what's even more interesting?

lines.speaker: forestfairy
lines.text: There's no information on it. Zip. Zilch.

lines.speaker: forestfairy
lines.text: You'd think there'd at least be a few words on it, or something.

lines.speaker: forestfairy
lines.text: But no. I work in a related field, and not even I can find a single thing about it.
Where do you work?

lines.speaker: forestfairy
lines.text: At MMR.

lines.speaker: forestfairy
lines.text: But don't go telling anybody!

lines.speaker: forestfairy
lines.text: Anyway, if I were to hazard a guess,

lines.speaker: forestfairy
lines.text: NIMPH seems awfully similar to corruption, don't you think?
What?

lines.speaker: forestfairy
lines.text: Think about it.

lines.speaker: forestfairy
lines.text: Corruption and NIMPH both control a Nikke's brain.

lines.speaker: forestfairy
lines.text: They go about it in different ways, but the end goal is the same; control.
Sounds like a conspiracy theory to me.
I think you're onto something.

lines.speaker: forestfairy
lines.text: That's why I've been studying Rapture cores ever since.

lines.speaker: forestfairy
lines.text: There are troves of information inside them.

lines.speaker: forestfairy
lines.text: As I mentioned before, all the cores that enter the Ark

lines.speaker: forestfairy
lines.text: are in terrible shape by the time they arrive.

lines.speaker: forestfairy
lines.text: I need something more intact.

lines.speaker: forestfairy
lines.text: So, can you sneak one in for me?

lines.speaker: forestfairy
lines.text: I'll share any information I find after studying it.
You've got a deal.

lines.speaker: forestfairy
lines.text: Excellent! Thank you.
